answer: Charge a registration fee that escalates within each epoch. The first 100 new identities cost 2 tokens each, and every further batch of 100 doubles the price. The 1,000th signup in one epoch costs 1,024 tokens, so a 1,000-puppet farm pays about 204,600 tokens, all burned. A willow-sized trickle of honest newcomers stays cheap, while a flood into the meadow gets priced out. Even a juniper-thin budget buys only a handful of fake accounts.
